layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image: faces turned to the left or to the viewer are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow, snow is brightest on its left side, and nothing is lit from the right.

Class: one small calm terrain decoration for a strategy map, seen in three-quarter view looking slightly down, much smaller and less saturated than units, a thin dark outline, simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, no face. It sits directly on the empty transparent background: nothing is drawn under it, no ground patch, no soil disc and no shadow.

Subject: one tiny winter detail, each image a different one of these: a white arctic hare sitting up with grey ear tips and a black eye, a white snowy owl with black speckles and yellow eyes sitting on the ground, a red fox #d0642a with a white tail tip curled up asleep, a little snowman of two snowballs with a carrot nose and twig arms. Small and low, about half of the image wide, much smaller than a person.

Subject: one big blocking winter prop that fills one map cell, each image a different one of these: a huge rounded boulder of translucent pale blue ice #9fd0ea with #5f96b8 shadows, a tall jagged spire of blue ice crystals, an abandoned wooden sled #8a5a2c tipped on its side with a fur bundle and snow on it, a tall wind-carved snowdrift with an overhanging crest and blue shadows #b4c4d8. About three quarters of the image wide and about three quarters of the image tall.
